# EarthDaily documentation


> Everything you need to know to master EarthDaily services


Last built: 2026-08-19


EarthDaily Analytics provides satellite imagery and geospatial analytics for agriculture, insurance, and environmental monitoring. For a full overview of EarthDaily's products and services, visit [earthdaily.com](https://earthdaily.com).

## Data > Collections (~3k tokens)

- [Landsat](https://docs.earthdaily.com/data/collections/landsat/): Landsat Collection 2 imagery available through EarthDaily (~268 tokens) [Landsat, Landsat 8, Landsat 9, surface reflectance, land surface temperature, 30m resolution, USGS]
- [Sentinel-1](https://docs.earthdaily.com/data/collections/sentinel-1/): Sentinel-1 C-band SAR imagery collections available through EarthDaily (~265 tokens) [Sentinel-1, SAR imagery, synthetic aperture radar, C-band radar, GRD, radiometric terrain correction, all-weather monitoring]
- [Venus](https://docs.earthdaily.com/data/collections/venus/): Venus L2A high-revisit multispectral imagery available through EarthDaily (~222 tokens) [Venus satellite, high-revisit imagery, 5m resolution, vegetation monitoring, CNES, multispectral, Theia]
- [EarthDaily Constellation Preview](https://docs.earthdaily.com/data/collections/edc-preview/): Preview imagery from the EarthDaily satellite constellation (~54 tokens) [EarthDaily constellation, EDC preview, daily global coverage, satellite constellation, high resolution imagery]
- [EDA Cloud Masks](https://docs.earthdaily.com/data/collections/cloudmasks/): EarthDaily's accurate cloud masking for Sentinel-2 and Landsat (~478 tokens) [cloud mask, cloud detection, Sentinel-2 cloud mask, Landsat cloud mask, Auto Clear Mask, pixel compositing, CloudSEN12]
- [Cropland Data Layer US](https://docs.earthdaily.com/data/collections/cropland-data-layer/): Annual crop type classification covering the contiguous United States (~55 tokens) [cropland data layer, crop type classification, United States agriculture, crop identification, land use mapping, USDA CDL]
- [AI Ready Mosaics](https://docs.earthdaily.com/data/collections/ai-ready-mosaics/): Cloud-free, radiometrically consistent mosaics optimized for machine learning (~119 tokens) [AI ready mosaics, cloud-free mosaics, machine learning imagery, radiometric consistency, satellite composites, analysis-ready data]
- [Biomass, Tree Height & Cover](https://docs.earthdaily.com/data/collections/biomass/): Multi-mode biomass density, tree height, and tree cover estimates at 10m resolution (~88 tokens) [above ground biomass, tree height, tree cover, carbon analytics, 10m resolution, biomass density]
- [Forest Mask](https://docs.earthdaily.com/data/collections/forest-mask/): Binary forest/non-forest classification at 10m resolution (~62 tokens) [forest mask, forest classification, land cover, 10m resolution, carbon analytics, deforestation monitoring]
